blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — Four gasoline stations in this city may be ordered to temporarily suspend operations for allegedly implementing a fuel price reduction smaller than those prescribed by the Department of Energy (DOE). Cotabato City Mayor Bruce Matabalao has ordered the City Inspectorate Team to conduct surprise inspection on gasoline stations in the city that delayed or did not fully comply with the Nov. 10 oil price rollback as announced by DOE. During its monitoring on Friday, Nov. 13, the inspectorate team found that Ace Power in Barangay Mother Tamontaka, Apex Quality Fuels, El Depot, and Fuel Tank Shell Service Station […]...
